summary: Complete UI/UX overhaul and functional engineering plan for Folio: fixes all container misalignments and text clipping, replaces the broken bottom bar with a standard Material 3 NavigationBar, removes all temporary dummy seed data in favor of real Android SAF file/folder permissions, adds automatic non-PDF-to-PDF conversion across all 31 tools, and introduces dedicated visual workspaces for Scan, Merge, Sign, and Split/Organize.
